title: Authentication UX
summary: Authentication protects accounts while reducing avoidable failure and supporting recovery.

MUST.text: Allow password paste, managers and autofill; use correct autocomplete semantics.
Support accessible authentication (WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.8): do not require cognitive function tests unless an accessible alternative or mechanism is provided.

SHOULD.text: Explain errors without exposing account existence where enumeration risk matters.
Follow NIST password guidance: minimum 8 characters, allow at least 64, permit all printable characters, screen against breached lists, avoid composition rules.

AVOID.text: Do not block paste, impose arbitrary composition rules or make CAPTCHA the only accessible path.

EXAMPLE.good: Password field allows paste and autocomplete="current-password"

FAILURE_MODES: Blocking paste breaks password managers; allow paste/autofill.
Account enumeration via errors; use generic messages.
CAPTCHA-only path excludes users; provide alternative.
